project_type: Full-stack monorepo: Python FastAPI backend, React Vite frontend, Cloudflare Workers edge layer
build_system: pnpm workspaces with corepack, pip for backend
test_framework: vitest for frontend/edge, pytest for backend
build_command: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile && pnpm --filter @workspace/syrabit run build && pnpm --filter syrabit-edge exec tsc --noEmit
verification_instructions: 1. pnpm install --frozen-lockfile 2. VITE_BACKEND_URL=https://api.syrabit.ai pnpm --filter @workspace/syrabit run build 3. pnpm --filter syrabit-edge exec tsc --noEmit 4. pnpm --filter @workspace/syrabit test 5. ruff check apps/backend/app/
setup_instructions: corepack enable && corepack prepare pnpm@10.26.1 --activate && pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET - full access. Node 22, Python 3.11, pnpm 10.26.1 available. No MongoDB available locally for backend tests. No Cloudflare credentials for deploy tests.
contribution_requirements: CI workflows must pass. Cloudflare Pages and Workers Builds are external integrations that cannot be fixed from code alone.
key_patterns: Monorepo: apps/frontend (@workspace/syrabit), apps/edge (syrabit-edge), apps/backend. Workflows in .github/workflows/. Frontend needs VITE_BACKEND_URL env var for build. Backend needs MONGODB_URI, APP_ENV, JWT_SECRET for tests. vitest 4.x requires explicit expect.extend(matchers) pattern.
directory_structure: Root: pnpm-workspace.yaml, package.json. apps/frontend: React Vite app. apps/edge: Cloudflare Workers. apps/backend: FastAPI Python app. .github/workflows: CI/CD workflows.
